honesty.trained: NOTHING HAS BEEN TRAINED. No model has been trained on these environments or on any episode they produce, and the repo records no training run. They are specs and a runnable schematic sandbox.
honesty.authored: Arenas, embodiments and dynamics are AUTHORED / SCHEMATIC (unicycle kinematics, circle obstacles); not the dynamics of any real robot, vehicle or ROV.
honesty.derived: Counts and limits named in `sources` are READ from sims/, ambient/, tasks/, restoration/, underwater/ and web/deepkit.py at build time.
honesty.scripted: Reference policies are SCRIPTED: hand-written, deterministic, seeded - no model, no network.
honesty.formats: Shaped after gym-style environment specs. Not an RLDS, LeRobot or ML-Agents file: no round-trip test exists in the repo, so no compatibility is claimed.
honesty.data: Episodes (training/ kind world-teleop) are opt-in per episode, device-local, and carry no names, emails, free text, audio, camera, biometric, device id or real-world location. Classroom / K-12 mode offers neither recording nor sharing.

sim.crane-lift.name: Tower Crane Lift
sim.crane-lift.brief: Pick the load from the supply pad, carry it over the stacks and set it inside the target ring — swing under control the whole way.
sim.crane-lift.observation_note: the seat's dash[] readout (the TRACE gauges); sims/ declares names and units, not ranges, so low/high are null rather than invented

reward.why: distance from target centre at release (m)
peak load swing during carry (m)
load or hook contacts with the stacks
seconds from hook to release

termination.when: the seat posts its results panel (simResults)
TRACE stops sampling at its cap (the run itself continues)

episode_cap.note: TRACE ~1 Hz, capped by training/ trace.max_samples

steps: slew and trolley the hook over the supply pad and lower it under 4.5 m
hook the load
hoist to carry height - clear of the tallest stack - before anything moves sideways
trolley in to a short radius, moving only while the swing gauge is low
slew round to the target bearing, moving only while the swing gauge is low
trolley out to the target radius, moving only while the swing gauge is low
hold everything until the swing dies away
lower the load to the ground
release once the swing is still
reference_policy.note: the scripted reference operator sims/ declares for this seat
